_comment: Shared by the Forge and NeoForge builds (tools/verify_loader_parity.py checks they are identical) and by tools/validate_glyph_mappings.py. They run against ../catalog.json: irons_spellbooks:firebolt (school fire, default levels 1-2 at tiers 1 and 2, registered 1-3), irons_spellbooks:heal (school holy, levels 1-2 at tiers 1 and 3) and the retired irons_spellbooks:ice_block. Terms list the tier the spell level is priced at.
